plugin.name: focus-follows-mouse
plugin._long: Moves keyboard focus to whichever window the pointer enters.

option.name: delay
option._long: Milliseconds the pointer must rest on a view before keyboard focus moves to it. Set to 0 to focus immediately. A small delay avoids focusing every window the pointer sweeps across.

option.name: cross_output
option._long: Whether focus may move to a view on a different output when the pointer enters it. When disabled, only views on the currently focused output are focused.
